hook: One Simple Way To Maintain The Health Of Your Prostate
claim: VitalFlow is a prostate capsule sold through a personal sales letter from a 45-year-old author who says he has researched prostate health for a couple of years.
story: The letter follows the same template as several other products we've reviewed ($69 one-time, 'FDA approved and GMP certified facility', 8-month restocking warning), and its formula closely resembles ProstaStream's.
ing_note: The letter names these 'and many more'; the full label and amounts aren't shown.
price_note: 3- and 6-bottle packages are discounted, with free US shipping; totals appear on the order page.
refund_note: The seller says refunds are given within 60 days even if the bottle is used up.
checks: Saw palmetto worked no better than placebo for urinary symptoms in the largest trials.
Pygeum and nettle root have modest supporting evidence.
Graviola has been linked to nerve damage with regular use.
The author's credentials can't be verified.
pros: One-time price with free US shipping
verdict: VitalFlow is a standard prostate blend with the same weaknesses as many others, plus graviola. A urologist can offer proven BPH treatments; if you want a supplement, choose one built on beta-sitosterol or pumpkin seed with a disclosed label.
